say:0:1831105001:1.text: A wineglass sits on the table in the VIP section, filled with deep red blood, almost congealed. You recognize it immediately as the blood you gave Tephesia.
say:0:1831105001:1.source_cn: 贵宾席桌上放着一个高脚杯，里面盛着深红色的、近乎凝固的...

say:1:1831105002:1.text: You can't help wondering what Graveborn blood smells like.
say:1:1831105002:1.source_cn: 亡灵的血闻起来会是什么味道？你不由得好奇。
say:1:1831105002:1.male: You can't help wondering what Graveborn blood smells like.
say:1:1831105002:1.female: You can't help wondering what Graveborn blood smells like.

say:2:1831105003:1.text: Of course, you deliberately ignore the fact that this was blood you gave her while you were a Graveborn. You're alive again now, after all. What does Graveborn <style="stress"><player_name></style> blood have to do with the living <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:2:1831105003:1.source_cn: 当然，你刻意忽略了这是你在亡灵状态下给出的血液，毕竟你...

say:3:1831105004:1.text: So you pick up the glass and take a deep whiff—
say:3:1831105004:1.source_cn: 于是，你端起高脚杯使劲嗅了一下——
say:3:1831105004:1.male: So you pick up the glass and take a deep whiff—
say:3:1831105004:1.female: So you pick up the glass and take a deep whiff—

say:4:1831105005:1.text: ... Urgh. Rotten. Rank. Like a hundred thousand flies had been crushed into a foul-smelling paste inside your nasal passages.
say:4:1831105005:1.source_cn: ……呕，腐烂，腥臭，仿佛有十万只苍蝇在你的鼻腔里被榨成...
say:4:1831105005:1.male: ... Urgh. Rotten. Rank. Like a hundred thousand flies had been crushed into a foul-smelling paste inside your nasal passages.
say:4:1831105005:1.female: ... Urgh. Rotten. Rank. Like a hundred thousand flies had been crushed into a foul-smelling paste inside your nasal passages.

say:5:1831105006:1.text: Enough of that. Holding your breath, you set the goblet back down. Now you see why Tephesia didn't finish it. This isn't a drink; it's slow torture for the senses.
say:5:1831105006:1.source_cn: 真是够了，你屏息着将高脚杯放回原位。现在你明白为什么苔...
